personality_one_liner: Trustworthy, highly accessible, and cleanly structured to serve patients and volunteers without friction, combining healthcare reliability with community warmth.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS padding. Minimum 16pt (lg) margins on screen edges. 12pt (md) gaps between cards. Keep thumb-zone CTA sticky at the bottom over scrollable content.

do's: Use frosted glass on the Home hero card overlay
Use glass on bottom tab bar and sticky bottom CTA containers
Layer glass over the logo or hero image for elegant depth
dont's: Don't use glass on regular list items or dense data tables in the admin calendar
Don't use glass behind standard text inputs

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Brand loading screen featuring the La Provvidenza logo on a cream background.

states.loading: Logo centered with a subtle pulse animation.

screens.layout: Full-screen surface. Image centered. Text 'Pubblica Assistenza Marsala' positioned at the bottom with safe area clearance.

screens.name: Home (Guest)
screens.purpose: Overview of services with a prominent call to action to book a medical transport.

states.loading: Skeleton of the hero card and service cards.

screens.layout: Hero card at the top (image background with vertical gradient scrim, large title 'Prenota un Trasporto' and primary CTA button). Below, a 2-col grid for quick links ('Servizio Civile', 'I Nostri Volontari'). Finally, a horizontal scroll section for 'I Nostri Servizi' (Dialysis, Wheelchair). Safe area padding at bottom.

screens.name: Booking Flow
screens.purpose: Guest-checkout style multistep form to book ambulance or wheelchair transport.

states.error: Banner at top showing validation or submission errors.

screens.layout: Step-by-step layout. Step 1: Large selectable cards for Vehicle Type. Step 2: Calendar & Time picker. Step 3: Vertical form inputs (Patient Name, Pickup, Drop-off). A sticky primary CTA 'Continua/Conferma' pinned to the bottom over a glass or solid container.

screens.name: Static Info Pages (Volunteers / Civil Service)
screens.purpose: Showcase the association's volunteers and civil service youth.

states.empty: Text 'Nessuna foto disponibile al momento' with an illustration.
states.error: Text 'Impossibile caricare la pagina' and Retry button.

screens.layout: Editorial layout. Large cover image with gradient scrim + Title. Followed by a clean text block describing the service. Below, a masonry or 2-column grid of ~10 photos showing volunteers in action.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Authentication entry point for Admins and Civil Service users.
screens.layout: Centered form on screen. Association logo at top. Email and Password fields. Sticky 'Accedi' button. 'Torna alla Home' secondary text link below.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Calendar management for slots, users, and booking tracking.
screens.layout: Top sticky section: Horizontal date strip calendar. Below: List of bookings for the selected date (each card shows Patient, Time, Vehicle, and status badge). A floating action button (FAB) tinted brandPrimary to 'Aggiungi Slot'.

screens.name: Civil Service Dashboard
screens.purpose: Read-only personal shift calendar for youth volunteers.

states.empty: Illustration + 'Nessun turno assegnato per questa data'.

screens.layout: Top sticky section: Horizontal date strip. Below: List of assigned shifts (Time, Location, Duties). No FAB. Clear and simple.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Primary is ANPAS Orange (#FF6B00), Accents are Navy Blue (#1A2E46) and Background is Cream (#FDFBF7). Do not use generic AI purples or default blues.
Implement the Booking Flow as a guest-checkout style process. No login required for standard users to book a ride.

For all images that act as backgrounds with text overlaid (like the Hero Home card), you MUST apply a linear-gradient scrim (transparent to dark) so the text remains readable. Use onSurfaceInverse for the text color on top of these images.
The codebase must be responsive for Web. Ensure the multi-column grids (like the Volunteers photos and Home links) wrap gracefully and the Booking Form restricts maximum width on desktop.
Set up role-based navigation logic after login. Admins go to Admin Dashboard (manage slots/bookings), Civil Service users go to their read-only Shift Calendar.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across all screens, with standard weights to keep the iOS-Native clean vibe intact.
